source: Beamstrike Rules 1.22 pp.31-39 (Armoured Vehicle Builder Chart, movement costs, accessories, crew ratings). Bike, skimmer and aircraft hulls are house rules calibrated against the rulebook example vehicles (pp.36-37).

hulls.name: Motorbike / Quad
hulls.notes: Up to 2 infantry weapons as fixed forward-firing mounts. Rider bought separately as infantry.

hulls.name: Trike
hulls.notes: Up to 2 infantry or light support weapons of the same type, fixed forward-firing and linked (fire as one, roll twice for effect). Rider bought separately as infantry.

hulls.name: Skimmer
hulls.notes: Up to 2 infantry or light support weapons of the same type (linked), or one AI turret (Robo-Turret, any weapons) instead of passengers. Rider bought separately as infantry.

hulls.name: Jetcopter
hulls.notes: Aircraft: one manoeuvre per move phase (take off, land, move anywhere / change altitude, hover). Firing at Low altitude adds 20" to range.

hulls.name: Transport Jetcopter
hulls.notes: Aircraft: one manoeuvre per move phase (take off, land, move anywhere / change altitude, hover). Firing at Low altitude adds 20" to range.

hulls.name: Drop Ship
hulls.notes: Aircraft: one manoeuvre per move phase (take off, land, move anywhere / change altitude, hover). Firing at Low altitude adds 20" to range.

hulls.name: Heavy Drop Ship
hulls.notes: Aircraft: one manoeuvre per move phase (take off, land, move anywhere / change altitude, hover). Firing at Low altitude adds 20" to range.

accessories.name: Turret Mechanism
accessories.notes: 360° arc for a main gun. One turret is already included in tanks and walkers.

accessories.name: Pintle Mount
accessories.notes: Infantry/support/heavy weapon mount with 180° arc; state facing.

accessories.name: Robo-Turret
accessories.notes: Holds up to 3 auxiliary guns in one space. Returns fire at small arms and missile fire.

accessories.name: Energy Shield
accessories.notes: Lasers, blast weapons, beam guns. -3 vs infantry weapons, -1 vs tank guns.

accessories.name: Projectile Shield
accessories.notes: Bolters, bullets, rail guns, missiles, grenades. -3 vs infantry weapons, -1 vs tank guns.

accessories.name: Multi-Shield
accessories.notes: Acts as ES or PS (one at a time). -2 vs infantry weapons, -1 vs tank guns.

accessories.name: Electronic Counter Measures
accessories.notes: -2 to hit for vehicle weapons firing at it; negates targeter bonus for others.

accessories.name: Automatic Defence System
accessories.notes: Destroys incoming missile/grenade/mortar on 6-0 (D10). Max 2 per turn.

accessories.name: Smoke Generator
accessories.notes: Leave one smoke-grenade area along the move path each movement phase.

accessories.name: Smoke Dispensers
accessories.notes: Fire 2 smoke grenades per fire phase (grenade launcher ranges), FF arc.

accessories.name: Magnetic Anomaly Detector
accessories.notes: Detects vehicles moving out of sight; shows size, not type.

accessories.name: Sensor Array
accessories.notes: Recon: designate off-table fire (3+), halve enemy concealment ranges. APC capacity halved.

accessories.name: Command Array
accessories.notes: Command vehicle: off-table support 3-6 for whole army, halve concealment. APC carries no troops.

accessories.name: Folding Dozer Blade
accessories.notes: Dig in hull-down: 1 move turn to deploy, 1 to dig, 1 to retract.

accessories.name: Digging Charge
accessories.notes: Blow a hull-down crater: 1 move turn to place, 1 to detonate. Infantry within 2" take a Standard hit.

accessories.name: Mech Jetpack
accessories.notes: Jump capability; see jet pack rules.

accessories.name: Mecha HtH Capable
accessories.notes: May fight HtH against mecha or foot troops.

accessories.name: Mecha Power Claws
accessories.notes: Requires Mecha HtH Capable.

accessories.name: Mecha Blades
accessories.notes: Requires Mecha HtH Capable.

accessories.name: Laser Painter
accessories.notes: Designates targets for laser-guided weapons and off-table fire support (equipment list cost).

accessories.name: Heavier Armour
accessories.notes: +1 hull class (e.g. Command Trike, Heavy Weapon Skimmer).
